title: Great Storage!
text: Great Storage!. My daughter recently moved out of her college apartment. She has a few weeks at home before she moves into her next apartment. When she moved out, she primarily used boxes and tubs. While everything is at home, we're transferring what we can out of the tubs and boxes and putting them into these bags. Of course, some things don't work well in these bags such as breakables or really heavy stuff, but they do work for many items. The advantage to using these is that she can unpack at her own pace and then fold the bags up and stick them under the bed or in the closet until she needs them again. With the tubs she has to empty them before we leave that day and send them home with us or bring them back on her next visit home. Her apartment is pretty small and she really doesn't have the space to store the tubs. These bags are very durable and sturdy. Plus with the handles, they are easier to carry than boxes or tubs.
